name: Xarol (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
When nature is threatened, who will speak for it? Xarols use druidic magic to communicate with the beasts of the wilderness and the wilderness itself. By gleaning information from these primal sources they learn exactly who they must pass judgment upon.

Speak for the Animals (Sp)

At 2nd level, at will, a xarol can use call animal, charm animal, commune with birds, or speak to animals at will as spell-like abilities. She can only use one of these at any given time.

This replaces detect alignment.

Speak for the Trees (Sp)

At 6th level, a xarol can use speak with plants as a spell-like ability for a number of minutes per day equal to her legendary inquisitor level. These need not be consecutive, but must be spent in 1 minute increments.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 6th level.

Speak for the Land (Sp)

At 12th level, a xarol can use commune with nature once per day as a spell-like ability.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 12th level.
